recap.text: Carl's explosives skill reaches five, and a new skill, IED, arrives at level three. It opens a menu titled Demolitions Workshop, but he clicks it and gets an error: he must stand in front of a Sapper's Table, sold in a Safe Room store. His trap achievement then pays out a Gold Sapper's Box, and the table inside nearly knocks him over. The box also holds ten proximity triggers.

Carl shoves the alchemy table against a wall and loads it with every alchemy item he owns, lays the Goo-inator 3000, the Gorgon Marital Aid and a dozen slightly-too-small goblin tools on the engineering table. In a glass-fronted donut shop in station 281, he orders coffee from the bopca Nodd and spends a free coupon on the table he wants. Hesitating, he hands both upgrade coupons across to raise his Sapper's table to level three, which lets him infuse bombs.

Carl clicks Sapper's Table on his training room's list, and a level-five copy of his own table pops up from the ground in his crafting studio, less scorched, with no residue from the hobgoblin disco ball to stick to his hand. A badger with an eyepatch and a hook for a hand fades in instead of the multi-armed trainer. He decides Carl is practically ready to teach him, then says the weapon Carl wants needs a different table.

beats.headline: A menu that needs a table
beats.text: Carl's explosives skills have reached five, and he has a new one, IED, at level three. An entire new menu appears in his interface, titled Demolitions Workshop. He clicks on it and receives an error: he may only access this menu when he is standing in front of a Sapper's Table, a workbench he may purchase from a Safe Room store. Interesting. That is something to explore if they ever make it that far.
beats.gist: Carl's explosives skills reach five, unlocking IED, but his Demolitions Workshop menu requires a Sapper's Table.

beats.headline: It nearly knocks him over
beats.text: Carl's trap achievement pays out a Gold Sapper's Box with two items in it. The first is a Sapper's table that practically knocks him over when it appears, a table just like his engineering and alchemy tables. Its description says explosives and traps created at it don't lose stability and can't be prematurely set off. The second item is ten proximity triggers, which only attach to a trap at a Sapper's Table.
beats.gist: Carl's trap achievement pays out a Gold Sapper's Box holding a Sapper's table and ten proximity triggers.

beats.headline: Against one wall
beats.text: In the crafting space, Carl shoves the alchemy table against a wall, and it clicks loudly into place with upgrade menus over it; he loads it with every alchemy item he owns. Then the sapper's table goes against one wall and his engineering table against the other. He expects to spend most of his time at the sapper table, but for now he stands at the engineering one, laying out the Goo-inator 3000, the Gorgon Marital Aid and a dozen slightly-too-small goblin tools.
beats.gist: Carl shoves the alchemy table against a wall, then sets up his engineering table opposite it.

beats.headline: Level three
beats.text: At the saferoom in station 281, inside a glass-fronted donut shop, Carl asks the bopca, Nodd, for a black coffee and the crafting table menu. It is a long list, most of it useless, at about 25,000 gold a table. He slides one of his two free table coupons across for the one he has been looking for. Then he presents his two upgrade coupons, hesitates over whether this is the right move, and asks to upgrade his Sapper's table to level three. A note in the cookbook has already told him what a level-three table does: it lets you infuse bombs.
beats.gist: Carl presents his upgrade coupons and asks Nodd to raise his Sapper's table to level three.

beats.headline: A copy, less scorched
beats.text: Carl's training room can teach him his workshop tables as well, and they need only be installed in his crafting studio. He finds Sapper's Table on the list and clicks it. A familiar level-five table pops up out of the ground, identical to his own, though less scorched, and his hand doesn't come away sticky with the residue the hobgoblin disco ball left. Instead of the usual multi-armed trainer, a badger with an eyepatch and a hook for a hand fades in, decides Carl is practically ready to teach him, and tells him the weapon he wants needs a different table altogether.
beats.gist: Carl clicks Sapper's Table, and a badger says his weapon needs another table.
